title: Native launcher depends on UNC current directory for worktree builds
body: To configure the assigned WSL worktree natively I had to pass -S with the UNC source directory and pass the preset-derived binary directory explicitly to the background build job. cmd.exe must stay on a drvfs cwd, while CMake 4.2 build presets resolve their file from the child job cwd. Consolidate path-aware source and binary roots in the native preset/launcher so each lane does not wire them by hand.
